title: Unidirectional moisture-conducting green fabrics prepared by a one-step electrospray technique
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1125-1133
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08289C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shumin Bi, Yueru Yang, Guangling Pei, Tianci Yang, Shui Hu, Qingxiu Jia
Unidirectional moisture-conducting fabrics were prepared by electrospraying polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) and polyvinyl chloride (PVC) onto three green fabric substrates, namely cotton, hemp, and modal.
